messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Seri Everbright Klinik Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Kedah (Healthcare).", "The register lists 2 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (100%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 57,991,924 and the after-tax profit was RM 3,850,478.", "The record lists 1 court case (1 as plaintiff)."], "menu": {"case": {"fact": "In CASE-2022-4166, the company is the plaintiff in a debt recovery (Dismissed, claim RM 107,700).", "next_check": "Verify the recorded disposition of CASE-2022-4166 in the case file."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was RM 6,121,061.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 7,799,454.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "earnings": {"fact": "FY2023 recorded an after-tax loss of RM 1,506,869.", "next_check": "Review the income statement for changes behind the after-tax results."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 1.54×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was 6.6%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 1995-12-03.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}, "trend": {"fact": "Revenue rose 20.2% from FY2023 to FY2024.", "next_check": "Check the sales breakdown behind the year-on-year movement."}}}
